ADR 0003: Stateful shell routing

Status: Accepted — implemented in Phase 1 Date: 2026-07-31

Context

The demo's custom Navigator has a feed root and paper routes. Production adds a Read destination and a You destination, each of which must retain its own stack and restoration state. Deep links must open a paper without resetting the selected destination, while paper-reader horizontal stages remain local UI state rather than routes.

Decision

Adopt go_router using StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack with Read and You branches. The shell owns persistent bottom navigation and separate branch navigators. Paper detail routes belong under Read; account and library routes belong under You. Root chat and comments surfaces cover the shell as modal/full screen routes.

The Read root retains the existing page-based linked-paper navigator inside its branch. This deliberately preserves the demo's exact paper trail, stage, scroll, and system-back restoration while go_router owns the production shell and public routes. Route restoration IDs are stable, and each public paper/arXiv invocation receives a fresh reader key so it begins on Abstract rather than reusing a prior in-screen stage. The paper reader's Abstract, Introduction, and Connections stage remains local interaction with its existing committed-transition preparation boundary.

Consequences

  • Switching tabs preserves scroll position, nested navigation, and selected state instead of rebuilding destinations.
  • Routes support /read, /read/paper/:paperId, public /p/:paperId and /arxiv/:arxivId entrypoints, /read/paper/:paperId/comments, /you, /you/library, and settings/account destinations without making comments a third primary tab.
  • Router, deep-link, restoration, back-navigation, and feature-flag behavior require focused widget and integration tests.
  • Disabled destinations must route coherently to an explanation or available guest surface, never leave dead navigation controls.
  • The nested Read navigator is an intentional compatibility seam. It should be reconsidered only after a migration can prove identical connection/back and scroll restoration behavior.

Security and operational implications

  • A deep link never supplies authority; protected actions still require the resolved server principal.
  • Route parameters are treated as untrusted identifiers and validated before loading data.
  • Restoration data must not include tokens, private profile data, comment bodies, or other sensitive material.
  • Stateful branch lifetime needs memory observation and cache-boundary testing on lower-end devices.

ADR 0003: 状态路由

状态: 已接受 —— 实现于第一阶段 日期: 2026-07-31

背景

演示中的自定义 Navigator 有一个 feed 根节点和 paper 路由。生产环境添加了 Read 目标和 You 目标，每个目标都必须保留自己的栈和恢复状态。深度链接必须打开 paper 而不重置所选目标，而 paper-reader 水平阶段保持本地 UI 状态，而不是路由。

决定

采用 go_router 使用 StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack 实现 Read 和 You 分支。壳层拥有持久的底部导航和独立的分支导航器。Paper 详情路由属于 Read；账户和图书馆路由属于 You。根聊天和评论界面作为模态/全屏路由覆盖壳层。

Read 根节点保留其分支内现有的基于页面的链接 paper 导航器。这刻意保留了演示中精确的 paper 追踪、阶段、滚动和系统返回恢复，而 go_router 拥有生产壳层和公共路由。路由恢复 ID 是稳定的，每个公共 paper/arXiv 调用都会获得一个新鲜的 reader key，使其从 Abstract 开始，而不是重用之前的屏幕内阶段。Paper 阅读器的 Abstract、Introduction 和 Connections 阶段保持本地交互，其现有的提交过渡准备边界不变。

后果

  • 切换标签页时保留滚动位置、嵌套导航和选中状态，而不是重建目标。
  • 路由支持 /read、/read/paper/:paperId、公共 /p/:paperId 和 /arxiv/:arxivId 入口点、/read/paper/:paperId/comments、/you、/you/library 以及设置/账户目标，而无需将评论作为第三个主要标签页。
  • 路由器、深度链接、恢复、返回导航和功能标志行为需要重点 widget 和集成测试。
  • 禁用的目标必须路由到解释或可用的访客界面，绝不能留下死导航控件。
  • 嵌套的 Read 导航器是一个有意的兼容性接口。只有在迁移可以证明相同连接/返回和滚动恢复行为后，才应重新考虑。

安全和运营影响

  • 深度链接从不提供权威信息；受保护的操作仍需要解析后的服务器主体。
  • 路由参数被视为不可信的标识符，在加载数据前进行验证。
  • 恢复数据不得包含令牌、私有个人资料数据、评论正文或其他敏感材料。
  • 状态分支的生命周期需要在低端设备上进行内存观察和缓存边界测试。
